entries.name: Hospital PETS+ San Antonio
entries.address: 75 m east and 150 m south of Pedregal, San Antonio de Belen, Heredia 40703
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, with a 24/7 emergency service; book appointments through its digital channels.
entries.note: Pages: 'Estamos abiertos 24/7', 'Contamos con servicio de emergencias 24/7', 'Abierto las 24 horas del dia, 7 dias a la semana'. Address on the hospital home page reads '200 S', on the contact page '150 S'; the contact page value is used. Phone is also WhatsApp and is listed as the emergency number.

entries.name: La Vete Hospital Veterinario Escazu
entries.duty: 24/7 emergency service, no call or appointment needed; stores open Monday to Saturday 8:00-20:00 and Sunday 8:00-19:00.
entries.note: Contact page: 'Servicio de emergencias 24/7 en Escazu y Curridabat SIN LLAMADAS NI CITAS PREVIAS'. About page: 'Hospital Veterinario 24 horas'. No branch address on either page (lavete.com/pages/tiendas not openable). Phone 4080-8333 is the general number (calls only); home delivery 8000-LAVETE.

entries.name: La Vete Curridabat

entries.note: Same contact page statement as Escazu (24/7 emergency in Escazu and Curridabat). No address on the page.

entries.name: Hospital de Especies Menores y Silvestres (HEMS-UNA)
entries.address: Campus Benjamin Nunez, Universidad Nacional, Heredia
entries.duty: University small-animal and wildlife hospital: Monday to Friday 9:00-19:00; weekends emergencies only, 10:00-17:00. Not a 24-hour service; call ahead.
entries.note: Page lists phones 2260-9234 / 2261-1775 / 2261-1274 and email hospitalespeciesmenores@una.cr; says 'atencion medica de calidad los 365 dias del ano' (not 24 h). Address is from a 2017 news article (campus Benjamin Nunez), not from the UNA pages opened. Hours conflict: UNA home page shows 18:00-21:00 under 'Horarios de atencion'; a July 2020 UNA notice (COVID) gave Monday-Saturday 10:00-17:00. Weekday/weekend hours here are from the hospital page; confirm by phone.

notes: Costa Rica: only 8 entries (4 x 24 h: Hospital PETS+ San Antonio, Petopia, La Vete Escazu, La Vete Curridabat; HEMS-UNA is not 24 h). Most clinics' own sites could not be opened: the fetch tool only opens URLs that surfaced in search results, and many clinic domains never did; some sites refused automated access (cavallinivet.com robots-disallowed, alltama.com robots-disallowed, medipetcr.com failed). No national or regional duty rota (guardia) found. No animal poison information line found: the Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios de Costa Rica website and any SENASA clinic directory could not be located or opened, and no official page naming an animal poison line was found (the human poison centre was not confirmed to take animal calls). Not done (24-h claims seen only in the vet24cr.com directory, not on own pages, so NOT added): Hospital Veterinario Cavallini (Tamarindo), Hospital Veterinario Santamaria (Alajuela), Hospital Veterinario Medical Care (Heredia), Hospital Veterinario Drs. Chacon (Guadalupe), VitalVet Cartago (El Tejar), Clinica Veterinaria San Juan (La Union), Veterinaria SALVET 24 (Cartago), Medical Pets (Cartago, Curridabat), Nuske Vet Center (Esparza), Guanavet (Liberia), IVDSA Santa Ana / Tres Rios, Hospital Veterinario Agromedica (Escazu), Clinica Veterinaria Ramirez (San Rafael de Heredia), Veterinaria Donde Chiza (Santa Cruz), Clinica Veterinaria Villa Mascotas (San Vito), Veterinaria Gocha (Santo Domingo de Heredia). Other leads without own page opened: Medipet Hotel y Hospital Veterinario, Veterinaria Argos, Pet Cafe, Pets Avenue, Innovavet, Exoplanet, La Vete Herradura (phone 2102 7028 on contact page, no 24 h claim), La Vete Alajuela/San Pablo/other branches (no addresses), Medismart network. Regions with no entries: Alajuela, Cartago, Guanacaste (Liberia, Tamarindo, Playas del Coco), Puntarenas/Jaco/Manuel Antonio/Quepos, Limon/Puerto Viejo, La Fortuna. Hospital Veterinario San Antonio (hospitalveterinariosanantonio.com) is in Tenerife, Spain, not Costa Rica. Rescate Wildlife Zoave (La Garita, 2433 8989) is a wildlife rescue with daytime hours only, not added.
